375 anapempo {an-ap-em'-po}

源自 303 與 3992; 動詞

欽定本 - send 2, send again 2; 4

1) (以高位權柄) 差送 (#路23:7|)
   
2) (送回原處) 遣回 (#路23:11, 15; 門1:12|)
record.edic_text:
375 anapempo {an-ap-em'-po}

from 303 and 3992;; v

AV - send 2, send again 2; 4

1) to send up
   1a) to a higher place
   1b) to a person higher in office, authority, or power
2) to send back

same.cexp: 差遣，打發；解送；委託，任命
差派；一路上幫忙；護衛，陪伴
